Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.2 Speaking Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.2 Speaking Fluency, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we make our oral presentations effective? 2. Why is it important to accurately pronounce sounds?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving as the learner make critical observations as they collaborate with others to analyse

the recorded or live skit on aspects of fluency namely accuracy, speed and expressiveness.

135

Values:
Integrity as the learner exhibits self-discipline while creating and performing a skit on the theme featuring the target

sounds and different aspects of fluency and recording it.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):
